author: TEDx Talks
description: Entre prompts, acordes y juego en vivo, Chiki y Juancho Valencia proponen una mirada lúcida sobre el presente creativo. Desde la experiencia de Puerto Candelaria, exploran cómo la Inteligencia Artificial puede ampliar el proceso musical sin reemplazar lo esencial: la emoción, la intención y la decisión humana. La tecnología acompaña, sugiere y provoca; el músico siente, elige y comunica. Una invitación a experimentar sin miedo y a seguir creando desde lo que ninguna máquina puede imitar. José Betancur es el líder visionario que está revolucionando cómo los profesionales y organizaciones se reinventan en la era de la inteligencia artificial. Su capacidad única para transformar equipos y empoderar talentos hacia convertirse en "arquitectos conscientes" de su potencial hace que sus conferencias se conviertan en experiencias transformadoras que desatan el crecimiento tanto personal como organizacional a través de metodologías revolucionarias que combinan Design Thinking, IA generativa y p
title: ¿Y si jugamos a qué suena el futuro? | Chiky Betancur + Juancho Candelaria | TEDxUniversidad EAFIT

author: TEDx Talks
description: Hay preguntas que incomodan porque todavía no tienen respuesta. Juan Camilo Giraldo abre un escenario inquietante sobre el futuro del marketing digital: ¿hasta dónde pueden llegar los mensajes?, ¿qué pasa cuando la tecnología cruza los límites de la conciencia? Una charla que no busca certezas, sino despertar criterio frente a lo que ya viene y todavía no estamos preparados para mirar de frente. Es diseñador gráfico y publicista. Mágister en estética e historia del arte y doctorado en ciencias humanas y sociales. Ha trabajado en varias agencias de publicidad y Universidades. Con clientes grandes y pequeños, públicos y privados. Jurado en los premios Effie y ganador de un Cannes Young Lions. Dedica actualmente su vida a la docencia y considera que su verdadero propósito es estar inspirado para inspirar a los demás. Su trabajo es sintetizar temas complejos y transmitirlos claramente para que otros los utilicen. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but inde
title: La incógnita del conejo verde | Juan Camilo Giraldo | TEDxUniversidad EAFIT

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Durante años nos dijeron que avanzar era cuestión de fórmulas, títulos o estrategias complejas. Guillermo Jaramillo desmonta esa idea y muestra cómo decisiones simples, bien leídas y tomadas a tiempo, han guiado sus movimientos profesionales, lo llevaron a asumir riesgos inteligentes y a innovar sin perder coherencia. Guillermo Jaramillo es un CEO internacional y emprendedor en serie con más de 25 años de experiencia en ciencias digitales, ESG y transformación energética. Su trayectoria se distingue por el desarrollo de modelos innovadores basados en inteligencia artificial y redes neuronales, aplicados a sectores estratégicos de alto impacto.

Es fundador de Dataifx, la primera fintech de Colombia y pionera en operaciones bursátiles digitales en la Bolsa de Valores, compañía adquirida en 2014 por el Grupo Santo Domingo. En 2008 creó Canal Clima, primer servicio privado de meteorología para el sector Oil & Gas, que utilizaba algoritmos de IA para anticipar condiciones críticas en oleo
title: El poder del sentido común | Guillermo Jaramillo | TEDxUniversidad EAFIT

author: TEDx Talks
description: La victoria más decisiva no siempre se ve en el marcador. Juan Pablo Ángel comparte cómo la gestión emocional, la disciplina diaria y la claridad de metas han guiado cada etapa de su vida: del fútbol profesional al emprendimiento y la paternidad. En conversación con Daniela Cepeda Tarud, revela que conocerse, entender qué te mueve y trazar el camino con rigor es lo que permite sostener el éxito en el tiempo. Una reflexión sobre propósito, carácter y la constancia que transforma talento en legado.  Juan Pablo Ángel es recordado como uno de los grandes íconos del fútbol colombiano, pero su historia va mucho más allá de la cancha. Tras una carrera internacional que lo llevó a vestir camisetas en Argentina, Inglaterra, Estados Unidos y Colombia, descubrió que el verdadero éxito no se mide solo en goles, sino en la capacidad de reinventarse y trascender. Su trayectoria refleja cómo la disciplina del deporte se convierte en una escuela de vida y cómo el liderazgo puede inspirar dentro y fue
title: La otra victoria | Juan Pablo Ángel | TEDxUniversidad EAFIT

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Gabriel Vallejo revela cómo el servicio, especialmente en los gestos más pequeños, puede transformar una experiencia ordinaria en algo memorable. A través de vivencias, muestra que servir no es una técnica ni un cargo, sino una forma de estar atentos al otro. Cuando el cuidado, la empatía y los detalles guían nuestras acciones, el servicio deja de ser una tarea y se convierte en propósito. Gabriel Vallejo López es un conferencista reconocido a nivel nacional e internacional, experto en servicio al cliente. Tiene una trayectoria apasionante, la cual recorre cargos como director del Departamento de Prosperidad Social (DPS), ministro de Medio Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible, y cargos directivos en organizaciones como el Grupo Editorial El Tiempo, Noel, NH Hotels, Mundial de Seguros y HSM (hoy WOBI) en América Latina. 

Ha dictado más de 1.500 conferencias en más de una decena de países, siendo invitado por compañías, gobiernos y organizaciones para compartir su visión de servicio, siemp
title: ¿Vivir o existir? El viaje inesperado hacia tu propósito | Gabriel Vallejo | TEDxUniversidad EAFIT

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Eskole lanza una invitación urgente: la imaginación no es un lujo creativo, es el punto exacto donde la ciencia se encuentra con lo humano. Con estructuras claras y ejercicios provocadores, nos recuerda que imaginar es una capacidad que se entrena y que, cuando se activa, abre el camino a las transformaciones más profundas. Una charla para volver a crear posibilidades donde creíamos que ya no existían. La conocen como “eskole”, el símbolo con el que recuerda que la escuela nace de un acto de ocio significativo, como lo entendían los griegos. Filósofa y líder, cree en el poder de las conexiones humanas para transformar la educación y la vida. 

De estudiante a rectora, es la primera mujer en liderar la universidad EAFIT. Profesora convencida y aprendiz eterna, cultiva espacios donde la ciencia y el arte, la razón y la sensibilidad, se encuentran para imaginar y sembrar futuros más libres, solidarios y sostenibles. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but
title: El Retorno de la Imaginación | Claudia Patricia Restrepo Montoya | TEDxUniversidad EAFIT

author: TEDx Talks
description:
A veces, la mejor forma de entender es dejar de aparentar que ya sabes.

David Llano comparte cómo jugar a ser el menos inteligente se convirtió en su fórmula para conversar mejor: hacer preguntas simples, escuchar sin prisa y permitir que el otro revele lo que normalmente pasa desapercibido. De ahí nacen entrevistas y conversaciones más profundas, honestas y llenas de descubrimientos inesperados.  David Llano es Cofundador y Host de Dinstinto, el podcast de emprendimiento más grande de Colombia. A través de conversaciones honestas con los mejores expertos y fundadores hispanohablantes, busca convertir las huellas del éxito en herramientas para quienes están
construyendo el futuro del emprendimiento en la región. Esa curiosidad que lo caracteriza, esa necesidad de entender cómo y por qué funcionan las cosas, hoy es el motor detrás de cada conversación que acompaña a miles de personas en distintos países del mundo. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but
title: Jugar a ser el menos inteligente | David Llano | TEDxUniversidad EAFIT

author: TEDx Talks
description: A arte não mora apenas no “centro” — e o centro não é geográfico, é simbólico. Desafie a ideia de que museus e instituições tradicionais são o único lugar onde a cultura acontece aceite a periferia como território de potência, criação e memória. Descentralizar não é favor, é reparação: é reconhecer que a quebrada já é galeria, já é museu, e que espaços culturais fora do eixo central são estrutura de base para formar referências, desejos e futuros. Mais do que ampliar acesso, o chamado é para democratizar decisões — quem escolhe, quem escreve, quem é pago para pensar cultura e quem segue invisibilizado. Ao defender arte nas escolas, praças e esquinas, a mensagem propõe que promover cultura na periferia não é “formar público”, é formar horizonte. Gisele Lima é pesquisadora, curadora e produtora cultural formada em Teoria, Crítica e História da Arte pela Universidade de Brasília. Dedica-se à investigação de processos de criação, trabalho artístico, produção cultural e curadoria dissident
title: Quem tem medo de ir ao museu? | Gisele Lima | TEDxBrasilia

description:
Johanna Summer & Malakoff Kowalski performing AN EMPTY HUNGRY GHOST: Amy Beach's YOUNG BIRCHES OP. 128/2 coupled with a poem by Allen Ginsberg (originally titled: DON'T GET ANGRY WITH ME). Recorded live at TEDxBerlin Women on Nov. 4, 2025 at Fotografiska.

author: TEDx Talks
description: Drawing on experiences from war-affected regions, pandemic response, and civic movements, this talk reflects on the impact of compassion-driven service. It shows how small, sincere actions can make a meaningful difference in individual lives. The talk invites reflection on responsibility, dignity, and everyday service. Dr. Bharat Kelkar is a highly respected orthopaedic surgeon and humanitarian known for his exceptional medical skill, compassion, and courage. A top-ranking doctor from KEM Hospital, Mumbai, he has dedicated his life not only to treating thousands in Nashik but also to serving in global conflict zones through the Doctors Without Borders (MSF), providing critical care to war-affected civilians in places like Yemen and Syria. Humble, disciplined, and deeply committed to his patients, Dr. Kelkar is admired as both a medical expert and a true warrior who heals, saves, and brings hope wherever he goes. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but i
title: What It Means to Go One Step Further in Times of Crisis | Bharat Kelkar | TEDxSanjivani University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In adolescent culture today, emotional distress is increasingly socialised and compared, creating what can be described as a competitive framework of suffering. Rather than functioning as a pathway to recovery, the sharing of trauma is often reinforced by social validation, peer comparison, and identity formation around pain. Mental well-being, in contrast, is frequently perceived as abnormal or unrelated.

The Mirror and the Maze: Part 2 analyses this phenomenon through a psychological lens, examining how social reinforcement, normalisation of unhappiness, and comparison bias trap teenagers in cycles of unresolved distress. This talk challenges the cultural mechanisms that glorify pain and reframes healing as a collective responsibility. By shifting from comparison to compassion, it argues for healthier models of emotional expression and support that genuinely promote recovery. Dr Sameer Golwelkar is an ordinary Human Being who has studied Technology, Finance, Psychology and Philosop
title: The Mirror and the Maze: Part 2 | Sameer Golwelkar | TEDxShishukunj International School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In today’s world, pain has quietly turned into a competition. As teenagers, we often share our struggles not to heal, but to measure ourselves against one another, who has suffered more, who has it worse. I’ve been part of that cycle. I’ve seen how trauma gets romanticised, how sadness becomes a personality, and how being mentally stable can feel almost out of place.

The Mirror and the Maze: Part 1 is a reflection on that experience. It explores how constantly comparing our pain traps us in a maze where no one actually moves forward. This talk invites us to pause, look honestly at ourselves, and question why we equate suffering with depth. By choosing compassion over comparison, we can rebuild a culture where support actually helps us heal, not perform our hurt. I’m an 11 grader who loves exploring how people think and express themselves and figuring things out while having fun doing it. I get curious about why people think the way they do and how a tiny idea can grow into something
title: The Mirror and the Maze: Part 1 | Apurva Acharya | TEDxShishukunj International School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Integrity doesn’t usually break in big moments — it slips quietly, in small compromises we learn to justify. This talk is an invitation to notice that gap between who we believe we are and how we actually show up. Drawing from research, lived leadership experience, and spiritual wisdom, this talk offers a simple, human way to realign our words, actions, and values, not through perfection, but through courage, clarity, and small daily choices that quietly shape trust and culture.  Mrs. Rajita Singh, a visionary people leader whose journey embodies the very essence of our theme, Seeds of Innovation. As the Chief People Officer, India, and Global Delivery HR Leader at Kyndryl, Rajita stands at the intersection of philosophy, purpose, and progressive leadership. She is known for transforming workplaces into human-centred ecosystems where culture, capability, and compassion grow together. With over two decades of shaping leadership thinking, she has been recognised among Forbes India’s Top
title: Unhypocrate: Leading with Integrity When It Matters Most | Rajita Singh | TEDxSanjivani University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a world that celebrates ambition and constant achievement, contentment is often seen as complacency. But is being satisfied with what you have a strength or a weakness that leaves you behind? Redefining Happiness challenges the tension between striving and settling, asking whether chasing endless goals truly fulfils us or just fuels exhaustion. In a society where competition is the norm, this talk questions whether happiness lies in relentless ambition, in quiet contentment, or in finding a balance between the two. It invites us to rethink success, not just as a race to the top, but as a deeply personal equation of meaning and joy. I am a 9th grader who considers herself akin to rain, not just because I was born on a day doomed to torrential downpours, but because I am not the kind of rain that falls quietly. Often described by my loved ones as someone whose standards exceed her height, I enter conversations clouded with questions and curiosity.
With my active involvement in MUNs,
title: Redefining Happiness | Aashita Kumar | TEDxShishukunj International School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: The stock market is more than numbers, charts, and trades; it is a mirror of human psychology. Stock Market & Self-Doubt, the underlying theme, uncovers how cognitive biases, herd mentality, FOMO, and regret aversion influence not just financial decisions but also our sense of self-worth. For teenagers stepping into adulthood, the market becomes both a tool for independence and a stage for vulnerability. This talk reveals how financial risks often feel like personal failures, and how early disillusionment can trigger long-term insecurity. By understanding the emotional side of money, we can learn to navigate not only markets but also the doubts that come with growing up in a world driven by wealth and risk. Debasish Maitra is an academic, currently associated with the Indian Institute of Management Indore, and a finance researcher specialising in financial markets, banking risk, and macro-financial linkages. His research interests span market risk, default risk, climate risk, and empi
title: The Psychology of Money | Debasish Maitra | TEDxShishukunj International School Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Uma declamação que transforma palavra em memória viva e denúncia. “Aláfia, mãos pretas” atravessa identidade negra e maternidade para expor como a exclusão, o racismo e a violência moldam o cotidiano — e como, apesar disso, existe criação, força e futuro. Entre luto e afirmação, o poema reivindica protagonismo: mãos pretas que constroem história, recusam a submissão e insistem em existir com dignidade, amor e ancestralidade. Nanda Fer Pimenta, nascida em Canavieiras (BA) e residente em São Sebastião (DF), é poeta, performer, escritora e agente cultural. Mestranda em Comunicação, transita pela poesia, moda e cultura desde 2012, vivendo experiências existenciais e políticas do ser mulher negra. Autora dos livros Sangue (2018), Dengo (2021) e Ananse (2025), é referência poética na cena de Brasília This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Aláfia, mãos pretas | Nanda Fer Pimenta | TEDxBrasilia

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this insightful talk, Nishant Bharadwaj reframes the conversation around AI and jobs, arguing that artificial intelligence is not replacing human creativity but amplifying it. By viewing AI as an “MRI of humanity,” Nishant explores how stories—rooted in emotion, culture, and attention—have always shaped history, markets, and movements, from freedom struggles to global commerce. As we transition from the Information Age to the Intelligence Age, the talk highlights the rise of microstories, conversational signals, and emotion-driven insights that define how brands, economies, and societies evolve. Through the lens of PingAura’s mission, Nishant shows why being discoverable in the right narrative matters more than visibility itself, and why the leaders of the future will be those who can listen to humanity’s quietest signals and turn them into meaningful stories. Nishant Bhardwaj — a 9-times Ironman, 350+ marathons, Senior Marketing Leader, High performance coach, Podcaster, who is th
title: The Future Is Stories: How AI Turns Human Signals into New Jobs | Nishant Bharadwaj | TEDxSIESGST

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Mir Sarwar is a distinguished Kashmiri Indian actor, director, and producer, widely recognized for his powerful screen presence and nuanced portrayals in Hindi cinema. Known for bringing authenticity to Kashmiri characters, he has made a lasting impact through notable films such as Bajrangi Bhaijaan, Kesari, and Laxmii, while consistently championing cinema rooted in his homeland of Srinagar.

Born and raised in Pandrethan, Srinagar, Mir Sarwar began his artistic journey in theatre and modeling before honing his craft through workshops at the National School of Drama (NSD), Delhi. His breakthrough came with Bajrangi Bhaijaan (2015), where his portrayal of the Pakistani girl’s father earned widespread acclaim and established him as a compelling supporting actor in Bollywood.

His diverse filmography includes Phantom, Dishoom, Kedarnath, Jolly LLB 2, Kesari, Hamid, Laxmii, Am I Next, and Ravrambha, reflecting his versatility across genres and roles. Beyond acting, he is an award-winning
title: The Collisions That Shaped My Becoming | Mir Sarwar | TEDxNITSrinagar

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this honest and inspiring talk, Aakash Salunkhe shares his journey from being a quiet, introverted student to finding confidence and identity through creativity. Growing up with no stage experience, no competitions, and a science background that didn’t go as planned—including academic failure—Aakash never imagined a life in content creation or acting. Yet, guided by curiosity, experimentation, and the courage to try something “out of the box,” he discovered photography, storytelling, and eventually digital platforms like YouTube and Instagram. From starting the “Eye Think” channel with friends to rebuilding from scratch after setbacks, Aakash’s story is about embracing failure, trusting small signals from within, and showing up consistently even when confidence is missing. His journey proves that you don’t need to be loud to be seen—you just need to begin. Aakash Salunkhe (known on Instagram as @aakash_itis) is a popular social media personality based in India. With a following of
title: The Future Is Stories: How AI Turns Human Signals into New Jobs | Aakash Salunkhe | TEDxSIESGST

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Neurons and Narratives, this talk explores how the human brain changes through the stories we repeatedly practice. Blending behavioral science, lived experience, and practical tools, the speaker shows how hope, repetition, and environment design can radically shift performance—often without changing the person at all.

The session opens with a striking neuroscience metaphor: how repeated experiences can rewire expectations and dramatically increase endurance. From there, the speaker shares a deeply personal journey—from academic failure and self-doubt to leading major businesses—revealing that the breakthrough wasn’t intelligence or opportunity, but a deliberate rewrite of the internal narrative.

Instead of theory-heavy neuroscience, the audience is given a simple, actionable framework:
Reframe, Anchor, Design, Prune, and Seal—five tools to manage stress, build resilience, and access peak states when it matters most. The talk also introduces powerful mental drivers around avoiding do
title: How Hope Rewires Performance | Shilpi Kulshreshta | TEDxSIESGST

author: TEDx Talks
description: As compras públicas movimentam uma parte gigantesca da economia brasileira e sustentam, na prática, a execução de políticas essenciais para a população. Ao explicar por que comprar com dinheiro público exige planejamento, transparência e processos formais, esta visão mostra como a tecnologia vem transformando lentamente esse mercado — especialmente desde o pregão eletrônico — e como a digitalização tende a se tornar regra em todo o país. Ao revelar que esse “gigante” é feito de milhares de oportunidades menores, com tickets médios acessíveis e baixa concorrência em comparação ao número de empresas ativas, o tema ganha um novo sentido: vender para o governo não é apenas uma estratégia de crescimento, mas também uma forma de fortalecer serviços públicos e ajudar a construir um país melhor. Analista de sistemas especializado em gestão pública. Desde 2016, atua como CEO do Portal de Compras Públicas, onde lidera iniciativas para incorporar as melhores tecnologias visando à eficiência das
title: Você também pode vender para o governo | Leonardo Ladeira | TEDxBrasilia

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this thought-provoking TEDx talk, Roshan Vadassery explores the powerful collision between artificial neurons and human narratives—and why our mistakes may be the most valuable resource of the AI age. Drawing from over a decade in deep technology, Roshan reframes failure not as something to hide, but as essential training data that fuels machine learning and reshapes how intelligence evolves. From the early flaws of generative AI to the future of work, abundance, and human purpose, this talk challenges the myth of the lone creator and celebrates learning as a collective, iterative story. As AI takes over repetitive tasks, humans are left with something far more important: the role of narrative explorers, teaching machines not just to compute, but to dream. Roshan Vadassery is a visionary technologist and founder of Permissionless, a decentralized organization building open-source infrastructure for the next-gen web. Coding since age 11, he now leads teams advancing AI, blockchain &
title: How AI Learns From Your Beautiful Mistakes | Roshan Vadassery | TEDxSIESGST

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dans un monde où le leadership est souvent associé à l’autorité, à la performance et au pouvoir, Ramatoulaye Camara nous invite à une réflexion essentielle :
Et si le véritable leadership commençait par le cœur ?
À travers son expérience au sommet de l’administration publique, elle partage une vision rare et profondément humaine du leadership, un leadership fondé sur l’écoute, la responsabilité, l’éthique et le service.

Dans ce talk, elle montre que diriger ne consiste pas seulement à décider, mais à prendre soin, à donner du sens et à servir avec conscience.

Ce message résonne particulièrement dans un contexte africain et mondial en quête de gouvernance plus juste, plus inclusive et plus durable.

“Réapprendre à diriger avec le cœur” est une invitation à une force nouvelle : celle de l’empathie, de la cohérence et de l’humanité dans l’action publique et le leadership.
 Ramatoulaye Camara est Secrétaire Générale du Ministère de la Culture et de l’Artisanat de Guinée.
Juriste et dipl
title: Réapprendre à diriger avec le cœur  | Ramatoulaye Camara | TEDxBambeto

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What makes people stop, listen, and give? In this talk, Samuel Stäbler combines insights from a large-scale scientific study of more than 80,000 pedestrians with his personal experience as a street musician. He uncovers the emotional and behavioral triggers that drive generosity and donation behavior—and shows how the power of music can change everyday human interactions. Samuel Stäbler is an Assistant Professor of Marketing at Tilburg University and an internationally recognized keynote speaker. He combines deep academic insights with compelling storytelling, making complex topics accessible and impactful for diverse audiences. His research focuses on communication and marketing finance and has been published in leading journals such as the Journal of Marketing and Marketing Letters. Samuel has received numerous international awards and delivers workshops on impact and presentation skills for scientists, students, and professionals.

As a passionate hobby musician, Samuel’s backgroun
title: Inspiring Human Generosity: Academic Insights from Street Music | Samuel Stäbler | TEDxEssen

author: TEDx Talks
description: Muhammad Ali is a young innovator, technology enthusiast, and public speaker from Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, currently studying in Class 9 at Green Valley Educational Institute. Known as one of the youngest TEDx speakers from Kashmir, he delivered a talk titled “Collisions That Create Change” at TEDx NIT Srinagar, where he spoke about curiosity, mentorship, and gratitude in shaping a learner’s journey. With a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, robotics, IoT, healthcare technology, and agritech, he has filed a provisional patent for a compact AI-based hemodialysis machine aimed at personalized patient care. A KEI Scholar, Muhammad actively engages in innovation challenges, research-driven projects, and youth-focused speaking engagements, inspiring peers through his ability to blend technology with social purpose. Driven by compassion and creativity, he aspires to become a changemaker and youth mentor from Kashmir, using innovation and communication to solve real-world problems
title: A young voice meets bold ideas—and change is born | Muhammad Ali | TEDxNITSrinagar

author: TEDx Talks
description: Et si le destin économique de l’Afrique n’était pas une fatalité, mais une construction consciente ? Dans cette prise de parole percutante, Folly Yves Dounou, stratège en innovation et développement commercial, invite à changer radicalement notre regard sur l’économie africaine. Au-delà des discours alarmistes et des récits hérités de la dépendance, il propose une lecture lucide et audacieuse : l’Afrique dispose déjà des ressources, des talents et de l’intelligence collective nécessaires pour bâtir sa prospérité. Ce qui manque, selon lui, ce sont des connexions efficaces, une vision stratégique assumée et le courage de repenser nos modèles économiques. À travers des exemples concrets et une réflexion profonde, il démontre comment l’innovation, les partenariats intelligents et le leadership local peuvent transformer les contraintes en leviers de croissance durable. Stratège du développement, Folly Yves Dounou fait partie de cette génération d’Africains qui pensent globalement et agisse
title: Réinventer le destin économique de l’Afrique | Folly Yves Dounou | TEDxBambeto

author: TEDx Talks
description: We live in a world full of cultural, generational, and interpersonal gaps — but often we’re moving too fast to notice them. In this talk, Mikaela shares how a literal fall through a Tokyo subway gap became a wake-up call to slow down, be present, and strengthen our ability to connect. Through personal life stories and a simple, practical framework, she offers a roadmap for developing impactful presence in everyday interactions — at work, at home, and in life. Mikaela is a multilingual speaker, leadership facilitator, and global citizen who has lived and worked across five continents. With a Master’s in Foreign Languages and an Ivy League MBA, she blends business acumen with cultural fluency. Drawing from over 15 years in Munich and past chapters in Argentina, Japan, the U.S., and beyond, her talks explore human connection across cultural, generational, and linguistic gaps. Known for her storytelling and quiet power on stage, Mikaela speaks on presence, empathy, and bridging divides wi
title: Mind the Gap: A Step-by-Step Guide to Impactful Presence | Mikaela Gallon | TEDxEssen

author: TEDx Talks
description: In Davids Talk geht es um einen Arsch voll Wissen. Wann haben wir den Bezug zum Hintern verloren? Haben wir ihn überhaupt je gehabt? Es fängt mit Hinternkunde an. Es wird als selbstverständlich hingenommen, daß der Körper wie eine Maschine funktioniert. Doch wehe, er ist mal kaputt. Im Zentrum geht es um konkrete Learnings und "one more thing" - ein Proktologe, der über 100.000 Hintern in seinem Berufsleben untersucht hat.  David Matusiewicz ist Professor für Medizinmanagement an der FOM Hochschule und Dekan für Gesundheit & Soziales. Matusiewicz zählt zu den bekanntesten Stimmen der Digitalen Gesundheit in Deutschland – als Keynote Speaker, Moderator, Herausgeber, Kolumnist und SPIEGEL Bestseller Autor. Why would a Japanese psychologist teach positive psychology in the Philippines — a country known for its smiles and resilience?
When Shinichiro Matsuguma, Ph.D., began teaching at the University of the Philippines Diliman, he quietly wrestled with a question: Why here?

In a culture where people often smile even through hardship, the true meaning of his work felt uncertain — until the honest reflections of his students revealed something deeper behind a culture often seen as “happy.”
What does it take to smile from the heart?
In this talk, Dr. Matsuguma reveals why understanding the value of negative emotions is essential to truly thrive — especially in societies where positivity is expected Dr. Shinichiro Matsuguma's revolutionary approach to positive psychology was born from a profound cultural exchange. Humans, Tech Culture & Al as Amplified Intention Step into a future where technology is no longer just a tool, but a culture shaping how we think, speak, love, learn and lead. In this bold TEDx Talk, Nrupesh Soni reveals how Al doesn't replace humanity, it magnifies it. What we feed into technology is exactly what we amplify in the world. A talk about wisdom over speed, intention over automation, and why the future belongs not to smarter machines - but wiser humans. With lived experiences across India, China, and Namibia, Nrupesh  doesn’t just talk about technology, he redefines it. 

To him, technology isn’t a product; it’s a philosophy. It’s a language that reflects our values, mirrors our culture, and asks us: what kind of future are we truly building?

From AI as Amplified Intention to slowness as the next great innovation, Nrupesh explores how we can remain meaningfully human in a rapidly digitizing world. His approach fuses storytelling, cultural metaphors, and systems thinking

 Frieda is a Namibian writer, editor, and performance poet whose work powerfully explores the intersections of memory, identity, and resistance.

description: This talk explores how humanity constantly upgrades its own systems—from the economy to technology—and questions what it really means to “install” these changes. Through the lens of artificial intelligence, it invites the audience to reflect on adaptation, belief, and progress in an increasingly complex world. György Lévay is a research engineer who, in 2010, lost several of his limbs due to meningitis. Ten years ago, he began working on enabling prosthetic users to adapt their devices to their own movements so that prostheses can function like real body parts, which led him to focus on robotics and artificial intelligence. Thanks to a scholarship, he completed his master’s studies in the United States at Johns Hopkins University. He is currently Head of Research at Infinite Biomedical Technologies and also works as a research engineer at Széchenyi István University.
